description: Department of Local Government - Notify the Names of Mayors & Chairman elected for 13 Local Government Institutions in Kurunegala and Puttalam Districts
reasoning: This gazette contains notifications of election results for local government institutions (Mayor, Deputy Mayor, Chairman, Vice Chairman) following the 2018 Local Government Election. It specifically falls under electoral processes and declarations, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7) rather than a government personnel gazette, as these are elected positions resulting from an electoral process rather than government appointments.
